title: El Salvador: Nayib Bukele, self-proclaimed “coolest dictator on earth”, is seeking a third term
summary: 🇸🇻 El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele, who calls himself the “coolest dictator on earth”, is seeking a third term after changing the Constitution to scrap presidential term limits. His war on gangs has made him hugely popular, but also sparked serious human rights concerns.
